newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM says policy focus not only on stocks - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM says policy focus not only on stocks - Jiji.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto told reporters on Monday that Japan's economic policy should not be formed only by looking at current stock prices, Jiji news agency reported.
Jiji said Hashimoto made the comment to Japanese reporters in Singapore, where he is on the last leg of a Southeast Asian tour. He is due to return home on Tuesday.
"It is not appropriate to manage the economy only by looking at the current stock prices," Hashimoto was quoted as saying.
He said Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama and Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka were expected to meet on Tuesday evening to discuss current management of the economy, Jiji said.

The Nikkei average of 225 leading shares fell more than 2,000 points last week on worries about the economy and the health of financial institutions, but on Monday ended above 18,000 on technical rebound.
